title: 30A Blue Retreat - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌴 Unwind at 30A Blue Retreat

A perfect blend of coastal charm and modern comfort, designed for a relaxed yet sophisticated beachside escape.

✨ Why You’ll Love It ☀️ Open, sunlit spaces with sleek, modern finishes 🌊 Breezy private deck overlooking the pool & spa 🏝️ Located in a private community 🚶‍♀️ Direct access to the Beachwood Villas beach access 🚲 2 adult bikes included — perfect for cruising along 30A 💕 Perfect for a romantic getaway or family retreat (sleeps up to 6)

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements 👑 Master Bedroom: Plush king bed, 55" TV, down duvet & soft linens 🚪 Private patio access from the master with poolside views 🛌 Guest Bedroom: Full bed + cozy bunk beds 📺 43" TV in guest room 💤 All beds feature soft linens & duvet covers 🛁 Bathrooms (Newly Renovated!) 🚿 Master bath with walk-in shower 🛁 Guest bath with tub/shower combo 🧴 Fluffy white towels & soaps provided

🍽️ Living & Dining 🛋️ Warm, inviting first-floor open-concept layout 👩‍🍳 Modern kitchen with island seating 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen: fridge, microwave, toaster, dishwasher ☕ Coffee maker + Keurig 🍽️ Spacious dining area for family meals & gatherings 🌴 Outdoor Living 🌅 Private patio steps from the master bedroom 🌊 Pool & spa views ☕ Shaded breakfast table by the pool 🌴 Surrounded by mature palm trees

📍 Prime Location 🍤 A couple blocks to Cafe Thirty-A 🦞 Reel ‘Em In Seafood nearby 🍕 Brozinni’s Pizzeria close by 🚲 Only 1.5 miles to Seaside

The ultimate charming coastal escape — where comfort, location, and relaxation come together beautifully. 🌊✨

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
